title: Extraction and sequencing of single nuclei from murine skeletal muscles
protocol: Dissect the muscles of interest and place them in 1 mL of ice-cold PBS+RNase inhibitor in a 2 mL tube.
Chop the dissected muscles with scissors for 2 min on ice until pieces are approximately 1–2 mm in size.
Proceed with nuclei purification by adding ice-cold lysis buffer after thawing frozen muscle samples for 5 minutes on ice.
Discard the PBS and add 1 mL of ice-cold lysis buffer.
Chop the tissue with clean dissection scissors for 2 min in a 2 mL tube on ice, resulting in pieces approximately 2–3 mm in diameter.
Transfer chopped muscle into a 15 mL tube and add 4 mL of lysis buffer.
Lysate for additional 3 min on ice with gentle shaking.
Add 9 mL of wash buffer to the preparation.
Transfer the preparation into the 15 mL Douncer.
Place the Douncer on ice and gently raise and lower the pestle 10 times, avoiding bubble formation.
Filter nuclei with a 70 μm cell strainer in a 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the 70 μm cell strainer with 1 mL of wash buffer without RNase inhibitor before filtering.
Collect and re-filter the flow through using a 40 μm cell strainer rinsed with 1 mL of wash buffer.
Transfer nuclei into a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 500 g, 4°C.
Gently discard supernatant up to the 2 mL level using an automatic pipetboy.
Manually remove remaining liquid with a P1000 pipette.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL of wash buffer + RNase inhibitor by gently pipetting 5 times.
Transfer resuspended nuclei into a clean DNA LoBind 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge for 5 min at 500 g, 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 500 μL of wash buffer + RNase inhibitor by gently pipetting 5 times.
Add DAPI to a final concentration of 10 μg/mL.
Incubate for 5 min in the dark on ice with gentle shaking.
Add 1 mL wash buffer + RNase inhibitor, gently pipette, and centrifuge for 5 min at 500 g, 4°C.
Resuspend the pellet by gently pipetting in 300 μL of wash buffer + RNase inhibitor.
Filter the nuclei in FACS tubes with a 35 μm nylon mesh-screen filter cap.
Maintain a 1.5 mL collection tube at 4°C.
FACS the nuclei based on DAPI staining, using an 85 μm nozzle and a flow rate pressure of 45 psi.
Collect a minimum of 10 000 nuclei.
Optimally, collect approximately 200 000 nuclei in 10 min.
Quality-control the nuclei preparation using brightfield or fluorescent microscope if necessary.
Mix 10 μl of nuclei with 10 μl of Trypan blue 0.4% for brightfield observation and spread on a glass slide.
Visualize nuclei under brightfield microscope after placing coverslip.
Directly spread nuclei on a glass slide without staining for fluorescent microscopy.
Visualize nuclei using DAPI filter and phase-contrast in fluorescent microscope after placing coverslip.
Prepare RNA sequencing libraries using either Chromium Single Cell 3ʹ Reagent Kits v3 or v3.1.
Encapsulate nuclei into gel beads with individual barcodes using the Chromium Controller machine.
Generate cDNAs manually following encapsulation.
Amplify and prepare the library for sequencing.
Sequence and analyze the library according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Determine the volume of nuclei to be loaded into the 10X Chromium Controller.
Divide the number of targeted nuclei times 1.6 by the concentration of nuclei after FACS.
If targeting 5000 nuclei with a concentration of 250 nuclei/μL, load 40 μL of nuclei into the machine.
Load twice the number of nuclei you will target into the 10X Chromium Controller.
Do not exceed a maximum volume of 41.3 μL for sorted nuclei loading.
If nuclei concentration is less than 200 nuclei/μl after FACS, sort at least 200,000 nuclei.
Centrifuge sorted nuclei at 500 g/10 min at 4°C and discard the supernatant gently.
Resuspend nuclei in a small volume of wash buffer + RNase inhibitor, such as 60 μl.
Precisely determine the concentration of nuclei using an automatic cell counter like Countess 3 Automated Cell Counter from Thermo Fischer Scientific.
Follow the 10X Genomics protocol strictly for GEM generation, RT, clean up, amplification, library construction and sequencing.
Demultiplex fastq files with the Cell Ranger mkfastq pipeline into library-specific FASTQ files.
Create a custom reference package including intronic and exonic reads using cellranger mkgtf and cellranger mkref according to 10xGenomics instructions.
Align the reads in the reference genome using STAR.
Filter and correct barcodes associated with aligned reads, retaining those with >200 and <2500 nFeature RNA and <5% mitochondrial genes.
Quantify reads associated with retained barcodes and use them to build a transcript count table.
Use SoupX software to reduce the level of background ambient RNA contamination.
Use Seurat software to filter and retain nuclei based on specified criteria.
Visualize data using Seurat software.
Cluster data using Seurat software.
Perform differential gene analysis using Seurat software.
